title: centaurium ruthenicum
intro: Centaurium ruthenicum, commonly known as Chiron, is a flowering plant species in the gentian family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium ruthenicum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
